evidence.quote: rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on

observations.why: Establishing a recurring rehearsal cadence appeals to security/stability (conservation) and readiness/capability (competence).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Equating unrehearsed with non-existent frames operational readiness as a competence value — capability that is untested is no capability at all.
Recording cadence and ownership as key decisions ratifies the conservation (regularized stability) and competence (accountable readiness) values enacted above.
